deviations: ROUND-2 LIVE DEFECT + FIX (2026-10-18, owner's emulator re-run vision-loop-1792358155819, same Riga goal): FALSE COMPLETION — step 2 tapped 'Search properties' via haiku-box-fallback at LOW-CONF (IoU 0.12) which did not run the search; the FINAL subtask's done-condition text matched the page's own hero heading ('Search hotels in Riga' is printed on the page) and the ACCEPT path — where the verification battery never spoke (it only escalates pre-act) — returned GOAL_ACHIEVED with the date picker open, default dates, and no results list (replans=0). FIX (VisionLoop + VisionPrompts only): (1) ACCEPT-SIDE BATTERY GATE — before ANY accept, if the ACTIVE subtask's battery carries outcome checks, the battery must CONCUR (VisionLoop.batteryConcurs: max-gate red flags refuse; every outcome check achieved via the same two-channel rule as batteryGate; a battery without outcome checks cannot speak — code rules alone); reuse fresh results when the battery already measured the same screen hash (a shared accept/pre-act REUSE-OR-RUN cache, cleared on subtask/plan change), otherwise run it at accept time; a refusal is loud ('ACCEPT REFUSED - the code condition is satisfied but the verify battery does not concur'), advances nothing, and feeds the existing failure/re-plan budget — for the FINAL subtask this prevents the false GOAL_ACHIEVED. (2) PLANNER LAW — PLAN_SYSTEM now requires the FINAL subtask to ALWAYS carry a verify battery over the VISIBLE end state (a results list, a confirmation screen, the cart contents — never a heading or hero text present on every page of the site; a badIsTrue check welcome); VISION_PROMPT_VERSION bumped v6 -> v7 per the file's own bump law (the phase-doc gate's 'v6 marker' describes the pre-fix build; the rebuilt APK carries v7).

ROUND-1 LIVE DEFECT + FIX (2026-10-18, run vision-loop-1792356890231): a battery escalation skips attemptStep, so an UNCHANGED screen re-fired the identical bad-is-true verdict every iteration — re-plans burned with zero actions into REPLANS_EXHAUSTED. FIX (VisionLoop only): the escalation-without-action guard `batteryEscalatedWithoutAction` — reset per run; set at the re-plan gate only when the same iteration's escalation came from the battery (stepEscalation non-null); the NEXT iteration then SKIPS the battery (loud 'battery held one step') and runs attemptStep normally; ANY action attempt (acted or failed) clears it; the battery re-arms from the following step; escalations still consume the existing re-plan budget; max-gate, thresholds, typed escalation, and evidence lines unchanged.

ROUND-3 LIVE RESULT + FIX (2026-10-18, budget coalescing): the loop now ACTS and the battery steers (Jev-box taps: date field IoU 0.73, then the 23 calendar cell IoU 0.51; the hold-guard worked) — new bottleneck: BUDGET COALESCING. The battery fired OUTCOME-ACHIEVED-WHILE-CONDITION-UNMET at step 4 (check-in date selected; the done-condition still pointed at the unset state — a genuinely mis-shaped condition needing the re-plan that would have said "check-in done, now select check-out") — but maxReplans (2) was already consumed by two earlier keep-acting red-flag escalations -> REPLANS_EXHAUSTED mid-progress. FIX (VisionLoop only): battery-driven escalations get their OWN counter `batteryReplans` with budget `batteryReplansPerSubtask = 3` (config) — reset on subtask advance AND on a failure-driven re-plan (a battery-driven re-plan does not reset its own counter: that would make the forced-PROCEED arm unreachable, which the mandated test forbids — interpretation recorded); gate order in the battery-escalate path: batteryReplans < budget -> re-plan (batteryReplans++, line "REPLAN (battery #N)"); else -> NO re-plan, forced PROCEED ("battery budget exhausted for this subtask - acting per cascade") and attemptStep runs (the act-first guard keeps the battery from re-firing before an action). The failure path (stuck/step-failures) still uses maxReplans per task; budget follows the ENTRY at the re-plan gate (a batteryReplanQueued flag set at the escalate site). Max-gate semantics, thresholds, and the existing evidence lines unchanged; the forced-PROCEED and battery-REPLAN lines are new-behavior additions.

notes: Implementation summary: WI1 — VisionPrompts gained the pure <jev-evidence> builder (typed EscalationKind, EvidenceCheck/EvidenceGrounding, routeStreak/ROUTE-REPEATED at >=3) and REPLAN_SKILL (appended beside the v5 manifest on the re-plan call only via planSystem); VisionLoop keeps a per-step CLASS-field cache (battery results, code verdict, best grounding, action/verb tails) so the failure context assembles the block with ZERO extra calls. WI2 — OpenRouterKeyStore second encrypted slot (typesafe-key); SetupLogic.typesafeKeyCheck (REQUIRED, R5 verbatim) + DualKeyTest/dualKeyLiveCheck (two independent verdict lines, never gates); SetupActivity dual tester (one 'Test keys' tap = free OpenRouter GET + minimal one-noul TypeSafe POST probe ~$0.000012, never auto-runs, each save resets its own verdict); VisionKeys (new pure object) resolves each channel intent > store > env > keys file and refuses LOUDLY naming the missing channel. WI3 — VisionJev defaults to https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone + jev-1.14.0 (adb extras override); endpoint+model recorded on every image-carrying call's evidence event. WI4 — the battery's Jev nouls ride text+IMAGE in one request, Haiku over its own channel; GROUND = ONE batched request (image in state + Box per tap/type proposal + pick-Choice); Jev box over the confidence floor is the PRIMARY grounding, the Haiku proposal box demotes to fallback + recorded cross-check; ordering law documented. WI5 — dual-key resolution + the probe on the live vendor Box path. WI7 — app/AGENTS.md vision/ + setup/ bullets, DEBUGGING.md two-key procedure, compliance log. POST-VERIFIER DEFECT FIXES — round 1: the escalation-without-action guard; round 2: the accept-side battery gate + the final-subtask planner law (see deviations for exact semantics).

Round-2 accept-gate semantics (precise): concurrence = no max-gate red flag AND (no outcome checks authored OR every outcome check achieved by the two-channel rule: text noul >= agreeAbove, or image-confirmed true with non-refuting text >= 0.5); both channels refused on an outcome check = cannot concur = refuse; no battery on the subtask = the code checker rules alone (the v7 planner law now guarantees the FINAL subtask carries outcome checks). Accept = codeDone AND concurs; refusal = loud line, no advance, consecutiveFailures += 1, step consumed, falls through to the ordinary stuck-probe/pre-act-battery/attemptStep machinery (the loop keeps acting).

Security: no key values anywhere in code/tests/logs; live keys exist only at runtime; tests use obviously-fake fixture strings, a pure CapturingTransport, and a nonexistent keys-file path so resolveKey can never read the developer machine's real .tools/keys.env.
